authority: Original captured client/config/declaration AST; independent pure planner, no captured JavaScript evaluated

planner.repeatedCursor: next token must differ from previous pageParam
planner.flatten: First occurrence of each calloutId, in served page/row order; no sorting

sortBy.description: Optional with an API key. A request without an API key must send it on every page: once automatedClientQueryReject is live, an unkeyed request that omits sortBy or sortOrder is refused 403 Client not allowed

sortOrder.description: Optional with an API key. A request without an API key must send it on every page: once automatedClientQueryReject is live, an unkeyed request that omits sortBy or sortOrder is refused 403 Client not allowed

includeMembers.description: Squad id only: true lists the squad's own posts plus every active member's, newest first ignored on a person id, except that sortBy=MULTIPLE with includeMembers is a 400 on any id. Re-send it with every pageToken request.

callouts.description: Can be shorter than the requested limit — rows whose callout is missing are dropped after the page is cut, so page on nextPageToken, not on array length

nextPageToken.description: Empty string on the last page; never omitted

calloutPrice.description: SOL-denominated; 0 both for a genuine zero and when the SOL price lookup failed open

maxPriceSol.description: SOL-denominated; 0 both for a genuine zero and when the SOL price lookup failed open

user_uuid.description: Unread by every known caller; kept for wire compatibility, and always empty on the list read

updates.description: Author updates (the author's own replies), newest first; empty when the route does not include them

viewCount.description: The only counter here that is not zero-filled: absent means unknown (no counter row yet), never a real 0

mediaUrl.description: Server-minted CDN URL; null when the callout carries no media

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

quotedCalloutId.description: Set with quotedCallout null means the quote target is hidden or unavailable, never "no quote"

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref; null when the row carries none

perp.description: Set only on a perp callout; maxPriceSol is 0 when set

assetClass.description: ASSET_CLASS_NFT_LIKE on a card callout (collectible set); absent on every token and perp row

collectible.description: NFT_LIKE card callouts only: the card (identity, grade, mark, insured value, buyback, listing); multiple is then the card mark over calloutPriceUsd. Absent on every token callout

tailBuyers.description: Distinct users whose buy was attributed to this callout; null = unknown (callout predates tail tracking).

tailCohort1h.description: Users tailPnl1hUsd covers (tailers whose first attributed buy landed before +1 h and whose window priced); null until the 1 h horizon is served.

tailPnl1hUsd.description: USD, whole-position PnL change of the tailing cohort over [callout, +1 h]; null until the 1 h horizon is served.

tailCohort4h.description: Users tailPnl4hUsd covers (tailers whose first attributed buy landed before +4 h and whose window priced); null until the 4 h horizon is served.

tailPnl4hUsd.description: USD, whole-position PnL change of the tailing cohort over [callout, +4 h]; null until the 4 h horizon is served.

tailCohort24h.description: Users tailPnl24hUsd covers (tailers whose first attributed buy landed before +24 h and whose window priced); null until the 24 h horizon is served.

tailPnl24hUsd.description: USD, whole-position PnL change of the tailing cohort over [callout, +24 h]; null until the 24 h horizon is served.

tailPnlHist1h.description: Per-tailer 1 h PnL histogram of the tailing cohort (server-defined buckets); null until the 1 h horizon is served, never all-zero buckets.

tailPnlHist4h.description: Per-tailer 4 h PnL histogram of the tailing cohort (server-defined buckets); null until the 4 h horizon is served, never all-zero buckets.

tailPnlHist24h.description: Per-tailer 24 h PnL histogram of the tailing cohort (server-defined buckets); null until the 24 h horizon is served, never all-zero buckets.

tailAth1hUsd.description: USD, best-case-exit PnL of the 1 h tailing cohort: sum over tailers of max(0, in-window bought amount x highest outlier-screened 1 m candle high - in-window buy spend) over each tailer's own window [first in-window buy, +1 h]; >= 0; null until the 1 h ATH arm is served (one horizon after tailPnl1hUsd) or unavailable.

tailAth4hUsd.description: USD, best-case-exit PnL of the 4 h tailing cohort: sum over tailers of max(0, in-window bought amount x highest outlier-screened 1 m candle high - in-window buy spend) over each tailer's own window [first in-window buy, +4 h]; >= 0; null until the 4 h ATH arm is served (one horizon after tailPnl4hUsd) or unavailable.

tailAth24hUsd.description: USD, best-case-exit PnL of the 24 h tailing cohort: sum over tailers of max(0, in-window bought amount x highest outlier-screened 5 m candle high - in-window buy spend) over each tailer's own window [first in-window buy, +24 h]; >= 0; null until the 24 h ATH arm is served (one horizon after tailPnl24hUsd) or unavailable.

tailAthHist1h.description: Per-tailer 1 h best-case-exit PnL histogram of the tailing cohort (tailer-anchored window, 1 m candle highs); five buckets from 0 up (first min 0, last max null), tailers sum to the 1 h ATH cohort and pnlUsd to tailAth1hUsd; null until served.

tailAthHist4h.description: Per-tailer 4 h best-case-exit PnL histogram of the tailing cohort (tailer-anchored window, 1 m candle highs); five buckets from 0 up (first min 0, last max null), tailers sum to the 4 h ATH cohort and pnlUsd to tailAth4hUsd; null until served.

tailAthHist24h.description: Per-tailer 24 h best-case-exit PnL histogram of the tailing cohort (tailer-anchored window, 5 m candle highs); five buckets from 0 up (first min 0, last max null), tailers sum to the 24 h ATH cohort and pnlUsd to tailAth24hUsd; null until served.

accountKind.description: 'group' = the squad's own post; 'person' = a member's or a single person's post

author.description: The row's author — the requested user on a single-author page, the posting member or the squad itself under includeMembers; absent when cc predates the field or the callout has no linked user.

calloutPrice.description: SOL-denominated; 0 both for a genuine zero and when the SOL price lookup failed open

maxPriceSol.description: SOL-denominated; 0 both for a genuine zero and when the SOL price lookup failed open

user_uuid.description: Unread by every known caller; kept for wire compatibility, and always empty on the list read

updates.description: Author updates (the author's own replies), newest first; empty when the route does not include them

viewCount.description: The only counter here that is not zero-filled: absent means unknown (no counter row yet), never a real 0

mediaUrl.description: Server-minted CDN URL; null when the callout carries no media

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

quotedCalloutId.description: Set with quotedCallout null means the quote target is hidden or unavailable, never "no quote"

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref; null when the row carries none

perp.description: Set only on a perp callout; maxPriceSol is 0 when set

assetClass.description: ASSET_CLASS_NFT_LIKE on a card callout (collectible set); absent on every token and perp row

collectible.description: NFT_LIKE card callouts only: the card (identity, grade, mark, insured value, buyback, listing); multiple is then the card mark over calloutPriceUsd. Absent on every token callout

421504.local:a.description: Session-deduped views; absent means unknown (no counter row yet), never a real zero

421504.mediaWaveform.description: Loudness shape of an attached voice note for a waveform player: 64 buckets 0..100, 100 = the clip's loudest bucket; absent on every other callout and on voice notes recorded before the waveform shipped

verifiedBadgeVisible.description: Badge rendering hint beside isVerified: show the checkmark only when both are true; true for user-less callouts

accountKind.description: 'group' = a squad callout: userId/userName/profileImage are the squad's while walletAddress is the acting admin's posting wallet; route the author press on userId + accountKind, never the wallet

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref; absent when the callout carries none

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

calloutId.description: cc's callout UUID; a row cc serves without one is mapped to callout null, so the key is never empty

chain.description: CAIP-2 chain of the called-out ref (hlcore:mainnet for a perp, ton:-239 for a TON callout, near:mainnet for a NEAR callout, starknet:SN_MAIN for a Starknet callout); null when the row carries none

assetClass.description: Asset class of the called-out position: ASSET_CLASS_PERPETUAL on an hlcore (HyperCore perp) callout, ASSET_CLASS_NFT_LIKE on a card callout (collectible set), ASSET_CLASS_TOKEN on every other row, chainless ones included

collectible.description: ASSET_CLASS_NFT_LIKE callouts only: the card (identity, grade, mark, insured value, buyback, listing); multiple is then the card mark over calloutPrice. Absent on every token callout

perp.description: Set only on a perp callout, whose calledOutAtMcap is 0

calledOutAtMcap.description: USD market cap when the callout was made; 0 when coin-communities captured none, never null

multiple.description: Current multiplier (live price vs callout price), 1 for an untracked callout; maxMultiplier is the all-time peak

mediaTranscript.description: Speech-to-text transcript of an attached voice note; absent on every other callout

hasLiked.description: null until a viewer is known

updates.description: Author updates (the author's own replies), newest first; empty when the route does not include them

commentCount.description: Live replies from users OTHER than the callout author

calloutPrice.description: Token price when the callout was made; 0 for callouts predating price capture, never null

repostCount.description: Live plain reposts of the callout itself; quotes do not count

hasReposted.description: null until a viewer is known

quotedCalloutId.description: Set with quotedCallout null means "quote of an unavailable callout", never "no quote"

actingUserId.description: Squad callouts: the admin who posted on the squad's behalf; presence is not the squad discriminator, the author's kind is

actingUser.description: actingUserId set with actingUser null means "unresolved", not "absent"

quotedCallout.description: The quoted callout one level deep (its own quotedCallout is always null)

assetId.description: The card's Metaplex Core asset id or pNFT mint

anyOf.description: Card provider. Known values: collector_crypt, phygitals
Lifecycle state of the card; listed while a marketplace listing is live. Known values: held, listed, bought_back, sold, redeemed, seized, burned, inventory

grade.description: Grading company and grade as one label (PSA 10); null ungraded

markUsd.description: The PnL mark the row's tokenPriceUsd and valueUsd rest on; null = unpriced

markSource.description: Price source the mark was picked from (buyback, standing_bid, fmv, listing, ...); null when unpriced

markAsOf.description: ISO instant the mark was observed

insuredValueUsd.description: Provider insured value; display only, never the mark

buybackValueUsd.description: The provider's current buyback quote; null when none stands

buybackExpiresAt.description: ISO instant the buyback quote lapses; null = no expiry

listing.description: Live marketplace listing; null when not listed

anyOf.description: Marketplace the card is listed on. Known values: collector_crypt, magic_eden, tensor, phygitals

verifiedBadgeVisible.description: Badge rendering hint beside isVerified: show the checkmark only when both are true

buckets.description: Server-defined buckets in ascending order; tailers sum to this histogram's cohort and pnlUsd to the matching horizon total.

callouts.description: Served callouts whose buckets contributed (1 on a single callout row).

421504.tailPnlHistogram.description: Per-tailer PnL histogram of the tailing cohort at one horizon, over server-defined buckets; clients render the bounds they are served, never a hardcoded edge list.

min.description: USD, inclusive lower bound of the bucket's per-tailer PnL range; null for the open-ended bottom bucket.

max.description: USD, exclusive upper bound; null for the open-ended top bucket.

tailers.description: Tailers whose horizon PnL fell in this bucket.

pnlUsd.description: USD, summed horizon PnL of this bucket's tailers.
